start: ^I set up our official Google Play Store presence and took charge of the entire release management workflow.
technical_detail: ^I configured our Google Play Developer account from scratch. This involved navigating store declaration policies, completing data privacy assessments, and satisfying compliance acts to ensure the app met legal store requirements.

^On the technical side, I managed our project settings, target API levels, and versioning structures within Unity. Instead of standard APKs, I handled building and publishing our compiled Android App Bundles (.aab files) to optimize down-to-device delivery sizes for our players.
